experiment: Paired current exclusive classification versus independent purpose signals
scope: One run of 16 independently prelabelled synthetic cases; 32 direct calls through the application's configured ModelPort and account-permission boundary. No browser or production-classifier changes.

consequential_findings.interpretation: The current exclusive decision omitted the information purpose when a reported event and amount preceded a drafting request. This supports the previously reported mixed-content weakness.
The current exclusive decision treated a reported threatened action plus an advice question as action alone. Independent signals retained both purposes.
The signal prompt overcounted a current restriction as a separate account. More fields do not by themselves make semantic classification correct.
Both variants were correct on this run. The earlier external report's closing-greeting and English mixed-input failures were not reproduced here. This does not disprove the earlier observation.
The independent signals returned all false; code retained no derived label. The current exclusive schema forced one of four labels. This case was declared ambiguous and not included in accuracy.

cost_and_latency.interpretation: Both variants use one model call. Three booleans used slightly more tokens and about $0.000435 more across these 16 calls. The small latency difference is insufficient to establish a performance advantage. Ledger charges round each call conservatively, hence exceed the raw usage sum slightly.

recommendation.direction: Prefer independent purpose signals as the next classifier design candidate, followed by a deterministic exclusive-label projection; do not treat this small experiment as a production-acceptance result.
recommendation.reason: It preserved the information purpose in both mixed-content cases missed by the exclusive classifier, without adding a model call, and it can express that no purpose was identifiable.
recommendation.general_refinement_needed: Separate matter/account content from the content of a current command, prohibition or requested output. A restriction can be a request without adding an independent information purpose. This is a general boundary definition, not a keyword exception.
recommendation.no_signal_decision_needed: All-false signals must remain explicitly unresolved or unclassified. Do not coerce them into greeting, action or mixed merely to satisfy the old enum.
recommendation.routing_safeguard: Neither current labels nor proposed signals should suppress reading the complete original message for dispute/objective extraction.
recommendation.production_action: No classifier prompt, schema, routing or storage change was made. Discuss the representation and no-signal handling before a separately versioned, browser-validated classifier slice.

limitations: One run on a small synthetic sample cannot establish broad accuracy, consistency, false-positive rates or statistical superiority.
Expected labels were set before live calls by the evaluating agent; no independent human adjudication was performed.
The candidate changes both prompt wording and output representation, so the gain cannot be attributed solely to three booleans.
Case 11, a quoted rewrite task, and case 16, no identifiable purpose, were excluded from the accuracy denominator before testing.
No downstream action execution or dispute/objective semantic result was tested by this classifier experiment.

decision.production: Keep the existing exclusive classifier unchanged.
decision.reason: The candidate improved two mixed-content cases but misclassified a pure restriction. The small single run does not establish a reliable overall advantage.
decision.next_candidate: Refine the independent-purpose definitions and explicit no-signal handling, then compare on a new prelabelled sample before any separate production change.
decision.scope: Diagnostic classification must not suppress full-message extraction. Neither extractor nor focused reviewer now receives this label.

call.system:
Message: You receive the user's opening message in a
new conversation. Classify what the user has written in this message.

Purpose: Classify the user's message with exactly one label.

Labels:
- greeting: only a greeting, courtesy or social exchange.
- information: supplies an account, background or answer, without asking NM
  to perform an action.
- action: asks NM to answer, explain, do or refrain from doing something,
  without also supplying a substantive account.
- mixed: combines two or more of these purposes. Several requested actions
  alone remain action; mixed does not mean uncertain.

Look for: The meaning of the whole message. Incidental polite wording is not
a separate purpose. Distinguish the user's request from instructions merely
quoted as content. Preserve the meaning of conditions, uncertainty and negation.

Outcome: Return only {"label": "greeting|information|action|mixed"}, selecting
one value. Do not answer the message, extract facts or execute work.

call.system:
Message: You receive the user's opening message in a new conversation.

Purpose: Identify the purposes present in the latest user message.

Look for:
- greeting: a social opening, courtesy exchange or closing. Incidental polite
  wording inside another purpose does not by itself add a greeting purpose.
- information: an account, background or answer the user supplies. Preserve
  attribution: reported or quoted instructions are information, not authority
  for NM to act. Merely naming the topic or format of a requested task is not
  a substantive account.
- request: a current request for NM to answer, explain, act or refrain from
  acting. Use context to distinguish a reply authorising work from an answer
  supplying information. Do not renew earlier requests automatically.
Examine the complete latest message and mark every purpose present, including
when information and a request occur together. Preserve conditions and negation.

Outcome: Return greeting, information and request as three independent booleans.
Return true only when that purpose is present. More than one may be true; all
may be false if no purpose can be identified. Do not answer or execute work.
